description: This Java class implements a platform service component that listens for loan status change events within the Apache Fineract project, specifically to handle actions like resetting the income balance when a loan is approved.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanStatusChangePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: A Spring component service that listens for loan status change events and triggers income balance resets when a loan's status changes to approved.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangedListener
classes.description: A private inner class implementing BusinessEventListener to handle specific loan status change events.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes the event listener for loan status changes upon bean construction.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent
methods.description: Handles the loan status change event, logging the change and resetting income balance if certain conditions are met.
